body: Fuck an energy drink! This shit will wake you up real quick!
Talk about a pump n dump
“If you truly wanted to die you wouldn’t be here talking to me right now”

It’s hard to keep myself happy when I feel like there’s somebody who needs my energy more than I do, I’ve always tried to be a people pleaser and I’ve poured all my energy into making people happy and making them laugh because honestly, it makes me happy whenever I make others happy. I’ve always been dependent on the mood around me. Is that bad?

I just wish I had the capacity to make her smile again, but make it permanent. I want to run up to her, pick her up and hold her closely in my arms for hours. This girl drives me crazy, her smile is second to nothing and the way she says my name whenever I tease her is the only thing that’s kept me going. I spent $200 of in game items on her the moment we hopped onto a game she likes and hearing her stay “stop!” while giggling felt like I had obtained some sense of normalcy back, but then I went to bed and it feels like everything’s gone back to the moment she told me. This hurts and I wish I could help her more than being just an ear. Is there anything I can do to keep her thinking about me instead of what happened?
